excerpts.text: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

Ravenous Flock
EFFECT RADIUS:
1100 • 250
SPEED:
1200
Innate: Enemy champions that die will leave behind a Soul Fragment for some time. Swain will collect nearby Soul Fragments, as well as with Vision of Empire and Nevermove. Soul Fragment: For each stack, Swain gains bonus health. Upon collection, he will heal for a portion of his maximum health.
Innate: Enemy champions that die will leave behind a Soul Fragment for 16 seconds. Swain's ravens will collect nearby dropped Soul Fragments, as well as rip the Soul Fragments out of champions hit by Vision of Empire or Nevermove's recast. Once a raven has collected a Soul Fragment, it will fly towards Swain to grant it to him, while also granting sight of its surroundings during the travel.
Soul Fragment: For each stack, Swain gains 15 bonus health permanently. Upon claiming a fragment, he will heal for 6% of his maximum health.

Active: Swain launches a demonic wave in the target direction. At max range, the wave homes back to Swain and detonates upon the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies as well as briefly revealing and rooting them. Nevermove can be recast while champions hit are rooted. Recast: Swain pulls the rooted champions and collects a Soul Fragment from each of them.
Active: Swain launches a demonic wave in the target direction.
At maximum range, the wave homes back to Swain and detonates upon the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and rooting them for 1.5 seconds, during which they are revealed. Nevermove can be recast while champions hit are rooted.
Magic Damage:90 / 130 / 170 / 210 / 250 (+ 70% AP)
Recast: Swain pulls the rooted champions over 290 units and collects a Soul Fragment from each of them, revealing himself for 5 seconds. If the targets would be pulled past Swain, they rebound off of him instead, knocking them back the excess distance.

Nevermove's missiles have their speed update to accelerate at specific times by the server. The client applies these speed increases after additional specified delays, while the hitbox behaviour itself only uses the timings noted above.
Nevermove's recast can be used during the cast time of other spells.
Spell shield will block either the detonation on the first cast or the pull from the recast.
If the recast is blocked, the target will also prevent a Soul Fragment being collected from them.
If the root is not applied to, removed or its targets blink or dash, the recast becomes unavailable.
The pull will interrupt channels at the very beginning, but does not keep the target stunned for the rest of the movement.
Channels can be started successfully during the pull, provided the previous crowd control does not prevent them still.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.

Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

Demonic Ascension
COST:
100 Mana
COOLDOWN:
120
CAST TIME:
0.5
EFFECT RADIUS:
650
Active: Swain frees the demon within, gaining Demonic Ascension and generating Demonic Energy. Demonic Ascension is maintained with Demonic Energy that gradually decays over time. Swain generates Demonic Energy while draining from at least one enemy champion, and fully restores it upon scoring a champion takedown. After a short time, Swain can cast Demonflare and does so automatically when Demonic Ascension expires. Demonic Ascension: Swain becomes ghosted and continually drains the lifeforce of nearby enemies, dealing magic damage and healing himself.
Active: Swain frees the demon within himself, gaining Demonic Ascension and generating 50 Demonic Energy. Demonic Ascension is maintained with Demonic Energy, which decays by 5 every 0.5 seconds, increased to 7.5 after 5 seconds have elapsed. Demonic Ascension is lost once all Demonic Energy is depleted to 0. Swain generates 10 Demonic Energy every 0.5 seconds while draining from at least one enemy champion, and fully restores it to the maximum of 50 upon scoring a champion takedown.
Demonic Ascension: Swain is ghosted and drains the lifeforce of nearby enemies, both dealing magic damage and healing himself every 0.5 seconds per target affected. The heal is reduced by 90% against minions and monsters.
Magic Damage per Tick:7.5 / 12.5 / 17.5 (+ 2% AP)
Heal per Tick:7.5 / 15 / 22.5 (+ 2.5% AP) (+ 0.75% of his bonus health)Reduced Heal per Tick:0.75 / 1.5 / 2.25 (+ 0.25% AP) (+ 0.075% of his bonus health)
After 2 seconds, Swain gains the ability to cast Demonflare, up to 100 times, and does so automatically when Demonic Ascension expires if Demonflare is not on cooldown at the time of expiration.
The targets do not have to be visible to be hit by this ability.
Swain can move during Demonic Ascension's cast time.

Original
05.10.2010
Jericho Swain is the visionary ruler of Noxus, an expansionist nation that reveres only strength. Though he was cast down and crippled in the Ionian wars, his left arm severed, he seized control of the empire with ruthless determination.. and a new, demonic hand. Now, Swain commands from the front lines, marching against a coming darkness that only he can see—in glimpses gathered by shadowy ravens from the corpses all around him. In a swirl of sacrifice and secrets, the greatest secret of all is that the true enemy lies within.
James Faulkner
Victor '3rdColossus' Maury
